qualification: This assessment is conditional on the actual hosted main run, successful native tests and independently verified file/OCI provenance. It is not an attestation or a third-party certification.

appropriate-platform.evidence: GitHub documents reusable workflows with artifact attestations as its Build L3 path. Only standard ubuntu-24.04 hosted jobs may produce this release; consumers reject self-hosted provenance.

consistent-process.evidence: Release calls the repository-owned build-base reusable workflow without caller inputs. Consumers pin its exact commit, source commit, repository and main ref before executing tools.

distributed-provenance.evidence: Every selected file and the immutable OCI builder have GitHub/Sigstore provenance, distributed as offline bundles beside durable release assets. Owner boot signing is a separate authority.

external-parameters.evidence: The reusable platform workflow has no caller inputs. The only accepted release context is Lanrith/lanrith main at its GitHub source commit; the release version is derived by the reviewed script. Source, workflow, run and attempt are recorded. Resolved dependency coverage is best effort and supplemented by locked inputs, SBOM and binary/source assessments.

hosted.evidence: All build, attestation and publication jobs select standard GitHub ubuntu-24.04 hosted runners; local builds cannot mark an image production-qualified.

isolated-caches.evidence: No cross-run build cache is restored. setup-go cache is disabled; Alloy rejects retained local cache inputs in GitHub Actions. Dependency/image downloads use the reviewed hashes, commits or OCI digests.

isolated-concurrent-builds.evidence: Standard hosted jobs run on separate freshly provisioned VMs. Container and native qualification processes stay within their own build VM.

isolated-remote-influence.evidence: No remote build/debug service is opened. VM administration is loopback-only inside a network-disabled container and authenticates a fresh disposable SSH identity. Package/source downloads are explicit build dependencies.

isolated-signing.evidence: GitHub/Sigstore retains provenance signing authority outside the build job. The attestation job receives immutable artifact IDs, never caller commands, boot keys or owner secrets.

isolated-subsequent-builds.evidence: Every job starts on a fresh hosted VM. No self-hosted runner or persistent workspace is accepted.

provenance-authentic.evidence: GitHub OIDC and Sigstore bind the repository/workflow identity to signatures. Consumers verify the issuer, exact signer/source commits, main ref, predicate and hosted-runner policy.

provenance-exists.evidence: The pinned attest-build-provenance action emits SLSA provenance v1 with cryptographic subjects and GitHub control-plane source, invocation and workflow identity.

provenance-unforgeable.evidence: Build steps have no id-token or attestation permission. A separate fresh hosted attestation job has no source checkout and executes no uploaded code. GitHub supplies required provenance fields; uploaded artifact names/digests are the permitted tenant-controlled subject fields.

security-practices.evidence: Pinned actions, source/tool/image/patch hashes, protected main review/checks, least job permissions, fresh Debian/custom advisory scans, native negative-path checks, retained rescans and a separate freshness watchdog. Trusted administrators retain the documented bootstrap bypass; no claim of third-party certification is made.
